question: Which of the following freedom fighters is also known as 'Mother Teresa of Western Odisha'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Parbati Giri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Parbati Giri** is fondly known as the **‘Mother Teresa of Western Odisha’** due to her immense contributions to social service and humanitarian causes.
 
• She was an influential **freedom fighter** who actively participated in the **Indian independence movement**, particularly in the Quit India Movement of **1942**.
 
• Born in **Sambalpur district** of Odisha in **1926**, she was deeply inspired by Mahatma Gandhi’s principles of **non-violence** and **self-reliance**.
 
• After independence, Parbati Giri dedicated her life to **uplifting the underprivileged**, focusing on issues such as education, healthcare, and women’s empowerment in Odisha.
 
• She played a vital role in the establishment of **schools and healthcare facilities** in rural areas, earning her the title of the ‘Mother Teresa’ of the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Rama Devi**:

 
 
• Rama Devi was a renowned **freedom fighter** from Odisha who also played a significant role in the **Quit India Movement**.
 
• She was deeply influenced by Mahatma Gandhi and worked for **women’s empowerment** and social reforms in Odisha.
 
 
 
• **Sarala Devi**:
 
 
• Sarala Devi was a prominent **poet** and **freedom fighter** from Odisha.
 
• She contributed significantly to the **Indian Nationalist Movement** through her writings and participation in political activities.
 
 
 
• **Annapurna Maharana**:
 
 
• Annapurna Maharana was a well-known **freedom fighter** and social worker from Odisha.
 
• She actively participated in the **Salt Satyagraha** and other movements led by Mahatma Gandhi.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Parbati Giri's Legacy**:

 
 
• Despite facing hardships during her lifetime, Parbati Giri remained committed to serving the poor and underprivileged.
 
• Her contributions to society have left a lasting impact, particularly in Western Odisha, where she is fondly remembered for her selfless service.
 
 
 
• **Recognition**:
 
 
• Parbati Giri’s efforts were widely recognized, and she continues to be celebrated as a symbol of **social service and dedication** in Odisha.
 
• Several institutions and programs in Odisha have been named in her honor to commemorate her contributions.
